main_menu.title: Growspace Manager
main_menu.description: Choose what you would like to manage

select_growspace_for_irrigation.title: Select Growspace for Irrigation
select_growspace_for_irrigation.description: Choose which growspace to configure the irrigation controller for.

remove_drain_time.title: Remove Drain Time for {growspace_name}
remove_drain_time.description: Select a drain time to remove.

configure_global.title: Configure Global Sensors
configure_global.description: Set up optional sensors for outside and lung room environments.

configure_environment.title: Configure Environment for {growspace_name}
configure_environment.description: Set up and fine-tune the environmental sensors and thresholds for this growspace.

data_description.irrigation_tank_volume: Total capacity of the tank in litres. Used for tank-based water consumption tracking when no flow sensors are configured. Leave empty to disable.

manage_growspaces.title: Manage Growspaces
manage_growspaces.description: Add, remove, or view your growspaces

add_growspace.title: Add New Growspace
add_growspace.description: Create a new growspace for your plants

manage_plants.title: Manage Plants

select_growspace_for_plant.title: Select Growspace
select_growspace_for_plant.description: Choose which growspace to add the plant to

add_plant.title: Add New Plant
add_plant.description: Add a plant to the selected growspace

configure_ai.title: Configure AI Settings
configure_ai.description: Set up the AI assistant for grow advice, notifications, and vision checkups.

select_growspace_for_env.title: Select Growspace
select_growspace_for_env.description: Choose which growspace to configure the environment for.

irrigation_overview.title: Irrigation for {growspace_name}
irrigation_overview.description: Configure the pump, schedule, and VWC crop-steering strategy for this growspace.

data_description.shot_sizing_mode: Duration Mode uses fixed shot durations; Volume Mode derives them from the pump flow rate and substrate volume.
data_description.growspace_id_read_only: The growspace these settings apply to. Read-only.

update_growspace.title: Update Growspace
update_growspace.description: Change the name, dimensions, or notification target of this growspace.

confirm_remove_growspace.title: Remove Growspace
confirm_remove_growspace.description: Remove {growspace_name} and every plant in it? This cannot be undone.

configure_humidifier.title: Humidifier Thresholds for {growspace_name}
configure_humidifier.description: Set the VPD band that turns the humidifier on and off, per growth stage and day/night cycle.

configure_dehumidifier.title: Dehumidifier Thresholds for {growspace_name}
configure_dehumidifier.description: Set the VPD band that turns the dehumidifier on and off, per growth stage and day/night cycle.

configure_advanced_bayesian.title: Advanced Bayesian Settings for {growspace_name}
configure_advanced_bayesian.description: Tune the Bayesian probabilities behind the environment sensors. Field names are derived from your configured sensors and are shown untranslated.

configure_sensor_placement.title: Sensor Placement for {growspace_name}
configure_sensor_placement.description: Give each sensor its X/Y/Z position inside the growspace. Field names are derived from your configured sensors and are shown untranslated.

configure_fan_controller.title: Circulation Fan for {growspace_name}
configure_fan_controller.description: Choose how the circulation fan is regulated and the speed range it may use.

configure_fan_vpd.title: VPD Fan Regulation for {growspace_name}
configure_fan_vpd.description: Set the VPD target the fan regulates towards and the critical temperatures that override it.

configure_fan_humidity.title: Humidity Fan Regulation for {growspace_name}
configure_fan_humidity.description: Set the humidity target the fan regulates towards.

configure_fan_temperature.title: Temperature Fan Regulation for {growspace_name}
configure_fan_temperature.description: Set the temperature target the fan regulates towards.

configure_fan_wind.title: Wind Simulation for {growspace_name}
configure_fan_wind.description: Vary the fan speed over time to simulate natural wind.

manage_strain_library.description: Add, edit, import, or export the strains available to your plants.

import_strain_library.description: Import strains from a ZIP archive, for example {default_path}. Imported strains are merged into the existing library.

export_strain_library.title: Export Strain Library
export_strain_library.description: The strain library was exported to {path}.

manage_breeder_blacklist.title: Breeder Blacklist
manage_breeder_blacklist.description: Breeders listed here are hidden from strain suggestions.

manage_timed_notifications.title: Timed Notifications
manage_timed_notifications.description: Add, edit, or delete notifications that fire on a given day of a grow.

add_timed_notification.title: Add Timed Notification
add_timed_notification.description: Send a message once a grow reaches the given day.

exhaust_fan_migration.title: Exhaust fans need to be re-enabled for {growspace}
exhaust_fan_migration.description: Exhaust fans are now controlled by the dedicated exhaust fan controller instead of the dehumidifier. Because of this change, the exhaust fans in {growspace} are no longer being cycled automatically. Open the Exhaust panel for {growspace} and enable the exhaust fan controller to restore automatic control. This was not migrated automatically because the old on/off humidity thresholds do not map onto the new speed-based settings.
